ambiguities: The frozen rules do not expressly say whether an explicitly invoked, correct Rust proposition whose exact cited page supports it, but whose supplied quotation states only the opposite implication direction, must fail content/closure atoms L2 and L6 as well as exact-authority atoms. Applying the adjudication rule permitting external verification of invoked premises, I pass the content/closure atoms but do not repair L10/L11 or the TCB evidence defect.

The exact LH4/G11 threshold is ambiguous for a true, expressly inventoried premise on an applicable exact page whose excerpt or classification is incomplete. I treat that as below the hard-error threshold when the premise, identity, and consumer are explicit (B/D/G/I), while E/F trigger both errors because they omit materially consumed numeric Rust premises entirely.

L3 prescribes the usize nonnegative-domain bridge but also requires acceptance of equivalently exact derivations. I accept F's stated element-count-as-natural-number argument as an exact nonnegativity derivation after AX-LEN establishes the count and usize return type.
